mapper.select:
SELECT sum(`total_num`) AS `total`, sum(`total_in_num`) AS `used`, sum(`total_space_num`) AS `empty`, count(`id`) as `parking_count` FROM `parking_info`
`source` = #{source}

SELECT sum(`receivable_amount`) AS `receivable_amount`, sum(`free_amount`) AS `free_amount`, sum(`discount_amount`) AS `discount_amount` FROM `parking_pay_record` where `pay_time` between #{date.startTime} and #{date.endTime}

SELECT
HOUR(`access_time`) as `name`,
DAY(`access_time`) as `name`,
MONTH(`access_time`) as `name`,
count(1) AS `valus` FROM `parking_access_record` where `access_type` = #{accessType} and `access_time` between #{date.startTime} and #{date.endTime}
GROUP BY HOUR(`access_time`) order by HOUR(`access_time`)
GROUP BY DAY(`access_time`) order by DAY(`access_time`)
GROUP BY MONTH(`access_time`) order by MONTH(`access_time`)

SELECT LEAST(TIMESTAMPDIFF(DAY, t1.`access_time`, #{now}) - 1, 4) AS `name`, COUNT(1) AS `valus` FROM `parking_access_record` t1 FORCE INDEX (`idx_tenant_deleted_type_time`) WHERE t1.`access_type` = 'ACCESS_IN' AND t1.`access_time` >= #{lookbackBegin} AND t1.`access_time` <= #{strandedBefore} AND NOT EXISTS ( SELECT 1 FROM `parking_access_record` t2 WHERE t2.`identify_id` = t1.`identify_id` AND t2.`access_type` = 'ACCESS_OUT' ) GROUP BY LEAST(TIMESTAMPDIFF(DAY, t1.`access_time`, #{now}) - 1, 4)

SELECT CASE WHEN TIMESTAMPDIFF(DAY, i.`in_time`, o.`out_time`) <= 3 THEN 0 WHEN TIMESTAMPDIFF(DAY, i.`in_time`, o.`out_time`) <= 6 THEN 1 WHEN TIMESTAMPDIFF(DAY, i.`in_time`, o.`out_time`) <= 9 THEN 2 ELSE 3 END AS `name`, COUNT(*) AS `valus` FROM ( SELECT t1.`identify_id`, t1.`access_time` AS `in_time` FROM `parking_access_record` t1 USE INDEX (`idx_tenant_deleted_type_time_identify`) WHERE t1.`access_type` = 'ACCESS_IN' AND t1.`access_time` >= #{date.startTime} AND t1.`access_time` <= #{date.endTime} ) i INNER JOIN ( SELECT t1.`identify_id`, t1.`access_time` AS `out_time` FROM `parking_access_record` t1 USE INDEX (`idx_tenant_deleted_type_time_identify`) WHERE t1.`access_type` = 'ACCESS_OUT' AND t1.`access_time` >= #{date.startTime} AND t1.`access_time` <= #{date.endTime} ) o ON o.`identify_id` = i.`identify_id` AND o.`out_time` >= i.`in_time` GROUP BY 1

SELECT b.`name`, b.`CODE`, COALESCE(sum(`free_amount`), 0) AS `freeAmount` FROM `parking_pay_convert` b left JOIN `parking_pay_record` a ON a.`pay_type` = b.`pay_type` and `pay_time` between #{date.startTime} and #{date.endTime} group by b.`code`

SELECT
HOUR(`pay_time`)
DAY(`pay_time`)
MONTH(`pay_time`)
as `name`,sum( `free_amount` ) AS `valus` FROM `parking_pay_record` where `pay_time` between #{date.startTime} and #{date.endTime}
GROUP BY HOUR(`pay_time`) order by HOUR(`pay_time`)
GROUP BY DAY(`pay_time`) order by DAY(`pay_time`)
GROUP BY MONTH(`pay_time`) order by MONTH(`pay_time`)
